patch_list: Disables Android FLAG_SECURE window protection in Cryptomator, allowing screenshots, screen recordings, and vault previews in the recent tasks overview.
Enforces dark mode and pure pitch black #000000 surfaces across Cryptomator's vault explorer, settings, and dialogs for maximum OLED battery savings.
Unlock Full Version & Permanent License - Cryptomator
Unlocks full version capabilities, bypasses 30-day trial expiration, suppresses license check warnings, and unlocks full read/write vault management across all Cryptomator variants.
